data.body_html:
Looking for a sotogrande boat rental marbella experience that combines luxury, convenience, and the Costa del Sol's best coastline? Departing from Sotogrande Marina, our fleet of 16+ yachts offers direct access to the exclusive southern coast of Spain. Whether you want to cruise to Estepona, anchor at Cala del Faro, or head towards Marbella's Golden Mile, every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and insurance. No hidden costs. Just you, the sea, and a day of pure Mediterranean indulgence.

Why Choose a Sotogrande Boat Rental Departure?

Sotogrande Marina is one of the most prestigious marinas on the Costa del Sol, located just 20 minutes from Marbella and 15 minutes from Estepona. Departing from here means you skip the crowds of Puerto Banús and enjoy a more relaxed boarding experience. The marina itself offers ample parking, restaurants, and direct access to the Mediterranean. With our boat rental Marbella service, you can start your journey from Sotogrande and explore the coastline at your own pace — from the sandy beaches of Sotogrande to the rocky coves near Cala Cortés.

Our Fleet for Sotogrande Departures

We have a wide range of boats departing from Sotogrande Marina, from sporty speedboats to luxury flybridges. Here are the most popular options:

  • Fairline Targa 12m (12m, 10 pax) — a sleek motor yacht ideal for day trips. €749/2h or €2,299/8h (Tier A pricing).
  • Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) — a luxury open yacht with a free jet ski on 4h+ charters. From €4,719 for 4 hours.
  • Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) — spacious flybridge with panoramic views. Pricing on request.
  • Pershing 46 (14m, 10 pax) — high-performance motor yacht for speed lovers. Pricing on request.
  • Speedboat (7m, 6 pax) — a fun, fast option for smaller groups. Pricing on request.

All boats include a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and 21% VAT. For the full list, check our fleet page.

Pricing and Inclusions

Our pricing is transparent and all-inclusive. Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39, Fairline Targa 12m) are priced at €749 for 2 hours and €2,299 for 8 hours. The Mangusta 80 requires a minimum 4-hour charter at €4,719, which includes a free jet ski. For all other boats, pricing is available on request via WhatsApp — we respond within hours.

Every charter includes:

  • Licensed skipper
  • Fuel for the entire trip
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava
  • Light snacks (e.g., olives, crisps, nuts)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21% VAT)

No extra fees for cleaning, docking, or tips. What you see is what you pay.

Best Routes from Sotogrande Marina

From Sotogrande, you have several stunning routes. A popular 2-hour trip heads north to Estepona's coastline, with stops at the beaches of Playa de la Rada or the quieter Cala del Faro. For a 4-hour charter, cruise towards Marbella — passing the Golden Mile, Puerto Banús, and the iconic La Concha mountain backdrop. Anchor at Cala Cortés for swimming and snorkelling. An 8-hour day can take you as far as Gibraltar (visible on clear days) or south to the pristine beaches of Sotogrande itself. Our skippers know the best spots for lunch, swimming, and photo opportunities.

How to Book Your Sotogrande Boat Rental

Booking is simple. For Tier A boats, you can book instantly online through our boat rental Marbella page. For other boats, contact us on WhatsApp with your preferred date, boat, and duration. We'll confirm availability and send you a payment link. Payment is secure via credit card or bank transfer. We recommend booking at least 48 hours in advance, especially during July and August. Cancellations are free up to 7 days before departure.

What to Expect on the Day

On the day of your charter, arrive at Sotogrande Marina 15 minutes early. Our skipper will meet you at the designated dock (coordinates provided in your booking confirmation). After a safety briefing, you'll board, and the skipper will navigate the route you've agreed upon. You can bring your own food (though snacks are provided), and music is welcome via Bluetooth. The boat has a bathroom, sun pads, and shaded areas. At the end, the skipper returns you to Sotogrande Marina. Simple, stress-free, and unforgettable.
